measured_tilt_safety_probe.dedicated_ctest_result: passed with the screen off and on

decision: Keep the clearance screen opt-in. Do not change the production default or interpret the long-walk stress case as green. Investigate shared long-walk SpeedLimit/read failures before 100-seed, ten-minute soak, or default promotion.
